description: This file contains the definition of the SubscriptionPlan model class for the Opencart platform, including methods for creating, reading, updating, copying, and deleting subscription plan records in the database, along with associated descriptions and status management.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription plans in the catalog, including CRUD operations and description handling specific to the Opencart framework.

methods.name: addSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Creates a new subscription plan record in the database and adds associated descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: editSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription plan record and its descriptions based on given data.

methods.name: copySubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Duplicates an existing subscription plan, including descriptions.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Deletes a subscription plan and its descriptions, along with associated product subscriptions.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription plan record by its ID, including description data for the current language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscription plans with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the active/inactive status of a specific subscription plan.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription plans, optionally filtered by name or language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a subscription plan for a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description records associated with a subscription plan.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes description records for a specific language across all subscription plans.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all description records for a specific subscription plan.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all description records that are associated with a particular language.
